headlines.title_cn: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
headlines.title_en: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
headlines.summary_cn: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another. However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman, Hugging Face’s chief policy officer, during a discussion at TechCrunch […]

items.summary_cn: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

items.title_cn: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
items.title_en: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
items.summary_cn: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
